integrity: The exhaustive C++ source enumerates all 3^9 and 3^10 monic equations (retaining squarefree ones); a separately implemented Python checker verifies the witness. The infinite family and threshold bounds are justified by a symbolic proof. No independent external audit or independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The uniqueness theorem concerns only genus-four hyperelliptic curves over F3; nonhyperelliptic cases are not classified. The genus-four uniqueness portion uses exhaustive exact finite computation. Originality may overlap unindexed arithmetic tables or broader published results.
title: The unique degree-four-place-free genus-four hyperelliptic curve over \(\mathbb F_3\) and an infinite sharp closed-point threshold
